steps.title: Initialize Project Configuration
steps.description: Establish package structure, compile targets, and base build environment.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and System Permissions
steps.description: Declare required install permissions, storage permissions, and custom file provider.

steps.title: Define Backend and Admin Schemas
steps.description: Specify local utility schemas for backend and admin configuration compliance.

steps.title: Create Native Content Provider
steps.description: Implement pure Android SDK FileProvider for secure APK package sharing and installation.

steps.title: Build AAB Analysis and Inspector Model
steps.description: Create data model to analyze and hold bundle structure, dex files, native ABIs, and assets.

steps.title: Develop Pure Java Test Signer
steps.description: Implement standard JAR/APK test signing and digest generation using native Java crypto.

steps.title: Implement AAB to APK Repackaging Engine
steps.description: Remap base bundle directories (dex, res, assets, lib) into standard installable APK format.

steps.title: Build Package Installer Session Handler
steps.description: Implement native PackageInstaller session and Intent-based installation pipelines.

steps.title: Design Material Layout Dashboard
steps.description: Create comprehensive layout with file picker card, inspection stats, progress bar, and console.

steps.title: Integrate SAF Document Picker
steps.description: Implement Storage Access Framework intent to securely select .aab and .apks files.

steps.title: Connect Real-Time Log Console
steps.description: Add dynamic logging view to track file parsing, zip extraction, alignment, and packaging.

steps.title: Implement Export and Share Actions
steps.description: Allow users to save converted APK directly to public storage or share via system sheet.

steps.title: Building AAB Installer
steps.description: Perform final compilation, manifest verification, and assemble debug APK.
